svg.aria-label: Staging and production: one account, one cluster, two workspaces
svg.title: Staging and production: one account, one cluster, two workspaces
svg.text: Staging and production: one account, one cluster, two workspaces
Staging is the same Terraform with a second workspace and an overlay tfvars · a name suffix on every resource · what it shares with production is reused, not copied
build pushes the same tag to both
same Keycloak, separate realm, same test user names

A plan whose environment variable disagrees with the workspace is refused · a non-production plan is refused while any import block exists in the directory · staging acceptance skips memory recall and scheduler ticks on purpose
